tools.name: get_recipient_profile
tools.description: Recipient agent profile bound to rwk_ API key: wallet address, key scopes, and registration metadata.

tools.name: list_my_loyalty_balances
tools.description: All loyalty token balances and tier levels for the holder wallet linked to this rwk_ key.

tools.name: get_my_loyalty_balance
tools.description: Balance and tier for one loyalty program token held by the authenticated recipient wallet.

tools.name: prepare_loyalty_token_transfer
tools.description: Build B20/ERC-20 transfer calldata for the holder wallet to send loyalty tokens to any address (submit tx locally).

tools.name: list_rewards_for_program
tools.description: List active rewards you can redeem for a program where your wallet has loyalty activity or balance.

tools.name: list_my_vouchers
tools.description: List vouchers issued to your wallet (active, used, expired) across enrolled loyalty programs.

tools.name: redeem_my_reward
tools.description: Redeem a reward into an active voucher after paying the token cost on-chain (requires transfer tx hash).

tools.name: list_p2p_offers
tools.description: List open peer-to-peer token swap offers; optional filter by loyalty token (same price band as merchant GET /offers).

tools.name: create_p2p_offer
tools.description: Create a P2P swap intent: offer loyalty tokens in exchange for another B20/ERC-20 token amount.

tools.name: accept_p2p_offer
tools.description: Accept another holder's P2P offer and record the match in Loyal Spark.

tools.name: cancel_p2p_offer
tools.description: Cancel a P2P offer you created before it is accepted.

tools.name: lookup_gift_certificate
tools.description: Preview a gift certificate by LOYAL-XXXXXX code without claiming (face value, expiry, program).

tools.name: claim_gift_certificate
tools.description: Claim an active gift certificate; binds it to your wallet (status active -> pending_mint).

tools.name: list_my_gift_certificates
tools.description: List gift certificates claimed by your wallet with optional status filter.

tools.name: get_reward_workflow_status
tools.description: Autonomous status planner for recipients: returns current reward redemption step and machine-readable next_actions[] (check balance -> prepare transfer -> redeem -> voucher).

tools.name: prepare_reward_redemption
tools.description: One-shot planner: returns B20/ERC-20 transfer calldata for the reward token cost plus the recipient_reward workflow so the agent can broadcast the tx and then call redeem_my_reward.

tools.name: bazaar_discover_resources
tools.description: Discover third-party x402-paid resources in Coinbase CDP's Bazaar registry. Read-only.

tools.name: bazaar_discover_mcp_servers
tools.description: Search Coinbase CDP's Bazaar MCP catalog (search_resources) for third-party x402-payable tools. Read-only, free. Rows are run via the Bazaar MCP server's proxy_tool_call, not here.

tools.name: bazaar_probe_x402
tools.description: Probe an x402 resource URL for its payment requirements without paying. Non-402 answers return an error, never the body. Read-only. No API key needed: keyless calls are limited to 20/minute per IP; with a key the key's own limits apply.

tools.name: bazaar_pay_and_call
tools.description: Pay an x402-protected endpoint with USDC on Base and return its response.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "claim_gift_certificate" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "recipient-loyalty-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bazaar_probe_x402 · Private data: get_recipient_profile, list_my_loyalty_balances, get_my_loyalty_balance, prepare_loyalty_token_transfer, list_rewards_for_program, list_my_vouchers, redeem_my_reward, list_p2p_offers, create_p2p_offer, accept_p2p_offer, claim_gift_certificate, list_my_gift_certificates, prepare_reward_redemption, bazaar_probe_x402 · Public sink: prepare_loyalty_token_transfer, prepare_reward_redemption · Destructive: bazaar_discover_mcp_servers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bazaar_probe_x402 · Private data: get_recipient_profile, list_my_loyalty_balances, get_my_loyalty_balance, prepare_loyalty_token_transfer, list_rewards_for_program, list_my_vouchers, redeem_my_reward, list_p2p_offers, create_p2p_offer, accept_p2p_offer, claim_gift_certificate, list_my_gift_certificates, prepare_reward_redemption, bazaar_probe_x402 · Public sink: prepare_loyalty_token_transfer, prepare_reward_redemption · Destructive: bazaar_discover_mcp_servers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
